_comment: Hand-verified corrections for waterway features whose gaugeId the build's nearest-waterbody heuristic (pickWaterbody in build-waterways-data.mjs) assigned wrong. The nearest NHD waterbody to a gauge isn't always the lake the gauge actually measures, so big named reservoirs sometimes got tagged to an adjacent lake's gauge (e.g. Lake Travis -> Marble Falls). Keyed by the feature's `name` property; value is the correct gauge lid from gauges-list.json. Applied at build time and by scripts/apply-gauge-overrides.mjs. Add an entry only after confirming the lid is the reservoir's own gauge (watch for creek-at-town gauges that share the lake's town name, e.g. LIVT2 'Long King Creek at Livingston' is NOT Lake Livingston; LVDT2 'Trinity River at Lake Livingston' is).
